law_name: Law No. 06/L-082 on Protection of Personal Data
scope: Data subjects in Kosovo; also non-established controllers using equipment in Kosovo
applies_to: All public and private bodies (incl. diplomatic and consular offices)
key_requirements: GDPR-transposing law (Regulation 2016/679) setting duties for public and private processors; AIP supervises
penalties_range: Fines up to EUR 40,000 or 2-4% of preceding-year turnover (sources conflict; one says flat EUR 40,000 cap) (unconfirmed)
notes: Gazette No. 6 dated 25 Feb 2019 but DLA Piper says in force 13 Feb 2019: dates inconsistent; adoption date not found. AIP took over National Agency for Personal Data Protection; effective_date earlier than enactment_date in the sources: the enactment date is used
